blocks.text: You can add, modify, or delete on-premises data centers on DSPM as required.
Make sure the following prerequisites are met:

blocks.item: Onboard the account using a custom model to establish network connectivity to the on-premises data center.
Modify security groups to allow connections from the scanner or orchestrator subnets.
Create a custom role with required permissions to configure SQL authentication.
Provide SQL connection strings and authentication credentials for our solution to access the on-premises data centers.

blocks.text: To add an on-premises data center to scan for sensitive data and posture risks:

blocks.item: From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > DSPM > On-Premises Data Centers.
On the On-Premises Data Centers page, click Add Data Center.
See image.
The Add New On-Premises Data Center drawer appears.
In the Add New On-Premises Data Center drawer:
Data Center
Data Center Name: Enter a unique name for the on-premises data center.
Location: Search for and select the region where the data center is located.
Business Unit: Assign the business unit to the data center.
Connect Scanners to the Data Center
Select On-Premises Scanner Integration: Select an existing on-premises scanner integration to connect with the data center.
See image.
Click Save.
The Add Data Center window appears.
In the Add Data Center window, click Confirm and Save.
See image.

blocks.text: The on-premises data center is added and displayed on the On-Premises Data Centers page.
To configure scan settings to scan the sensitive data in the on-premises data center, see Configuring Scan Settings for On-Premises Data Center.
To edit an on-premises data center:

blocks.item: Go to Data Security > DSPM > On-Premises Data Centers.
Do one of the following:
Click Actions (), and select Edit for the required data center.
See image.
Click the name of the data center to go to the On-Premises Data Center details page, then click Actions and select Edit.
See image.
The Edit Data Center window appears.
In the Edit Data Center window, click Proceed to continue.
See image.
The Edit On-Premises Data Center drawer appears.
In the Edit On-Premises Data Center drawer, update the following:
Business Unit: Update the business unit for the data center.
Connect Scanners to the Data Center: Update the scanner integrations that must be linked to the data center.
Select On-Premises Scanner Integration: Update an existing on-premises scanner integration to connect with the data center.
See image.
Click Save.

blocks.text: The on-premises data center is updated.
Changes made to the on-premises data center configuration only take effect at the next scheduled scan.
To delete an on-premises data center:
Deleting an on-premises data center is restricted if it is associated with any unmanaged databases. The Delete option is grayed out in such cases.

blocks.item: Go to Data Security > DSPM > On-Premises Data Centers.
Do one of the following:
Click Actions (), and select Delete for the required data center.
See image.
Click the name of the data center to go to the On-Premises Data Center details page, then click Actions and select Delete.
See image.
The Delete Data Center window appears.
In the Delete Data Center window, read the message, and then enter CONFIRM in the text box.
See image.
Click Delete Server.

blocks.text: The on-premises data center is deleted from the Zscaler Admin Console.
